scope: Normalization-readiness caveat resolution for the already researched Sjuhäradsleden candidate files. This pass resolves import policy decisions and reduces source uncertainty, but does not integrate runtime data.

method.summary: Reviewed the section-level caveats, made normalization policy decisions for endpoint/access clusters, geometry source precedence, facility import/suppress/pending actions, water/fire/transit handling, and ran targeted official-source checks for protected-area clipping and current fire status.

routeGeometry.primarySource: Naturkartan per-section GPX/API for all sections, preserving official stage order and section-to-section continuity.
routeGeometry.secondarySource: OSM relations are cross-checks for topology, endpoint sanity and related-route overlaps. Do not replace Naturkartan geometry with OSM unless an explicit geometry QA task decides to do so.

sectionSpecificActions.decision: Normalize the Rölle duplicate/parallel/spur artifacts into one mainline before import. Do not use the Rölle partial-segment coordinate as an endpoint.
Densify/resample the known 838.6 m simplified chord before import. Keep the Naturkartan official route corridor and do not snap endpoint display directly to Prångens Camping access objects.
Preserve or explicitly bridge the three Naturkartan GPX components and reverse OSM if used. Treat the Borås stage-8 Böne easting 4120226 as a typo and use 412026 for Borås-derived Böne metadata.

Use Naturkartan GPX/API as planning-grade primary geometry. OSM relation 5607240 is continuous but stored in reverse order and locally deviates from Naturkartan by up to about 100 m; reverse and use only as cross-check/overlap source.

endpointAndAccessClusters.defaultPolicy: Keep route-line endpoints from Naturkartan for geometry continuity. Model named trailheads, parking, clubhouses, hotels, campgrounds, churches and transit stops as separate access/facility clusters with route-proximity metadata.

clusters.decision: Use station/access cluster for user-facing start services; use GPX vertex for route geometry.
Do not force the route endpoint to the access coordinate. Keep GPX endpoint near Brandshed for continuity and show Hestrafors IF/Bollevi as practical access cluster with weak transit caveat.
Use IK Omega as official route boundary. Model Omegastugan/Olsfors lower access as separate access metadata, not as the section boundary.
Use Naturkartan section-continuity vertex for geometry; model SOK-stugan/Nordtorp clubhouse and parking as practical access/facility cluster about 190-200 m away.
Use Naturkartan continuity vertex for geometry; model Rya åsar/Björbobacken/Björbostugan/Ramshulan as a deduplicated reserve access/facility cluster.
Keep Naturkartan endpoint for route continuity and model Karlsaflogarna/Häljaredsvägen/Toarp kyrka as nearby access/service metadata.
Use the section 6/7 continuity point as route boundary. Treat direct public transport as weak; do not import Komskälet/Kommskälet as a current confirmed stop.
Keep route-line endpoint and Prångens Camping/badplats/parking/toilet/service objects deduplicated but separate from nearby Ulricehamn town-service metadata.

Use the corrected Borås/SWEREF easting 412026 when deriving Böne access metadata. Model Böne kyrka and parking as heritage/access cluster; suppress potable-water and toilet/open-church service claims.
Use Årås säteri as official section label and store Årås kvarn/Årås Säteri aliases in one endpoint service/heritage cluster. Do not duplicate section 9 and 10 Årås facilities.
Use Hotell Mullsjö as official endpoint label. Keep hotel building, ledentré, bus stop, bathing place and Mullsjö C access trail as separate endpoint access/service records.

water.defaultPolicy: Do not import springs, church taps, lake water or service-facility water as potable unless a current source explicitly confirms public drinking-water access. Natural water can be mapped as natural/bathing/rest context only.
resolvedActions: Böne kyrka water: suppress as potable; 2025 field report says signed not drinkable.
Jordkulan spring: suppress as reliable potable; field report found Rabbaberget/Jordkulan-area water empty/unreliable and OSM does not prove potability.
Raska-Minas källa: keep pending/non-potable until exact coordinate and potability are confirmed.
Årås water: model only as guest/customer/service metadata.
Mullsjö Hotell tap: keep pending until exact coordinate and public access are confirmed.
Ryfors Golfklubb and Mullsjö Camping water: service/guest metadata only.

fireAndCamping.defaultPolicy: Current fire-ban status is dynamic and must be checked on import/publication day. Reserve-specific rules override municipal no-fire-ban status.

currentFireStatusChecked.importImpact: Do not store this as a stable no-fire-ban fact. It only confirms the status observed during this caveat pass.

resolvedActions: Suppress Struntfiskeboa firepit unless a later authority source explicitly permits it; official protected-area clipping places it inside Årås naturreservat, where fires are forbidden.
Keep Struntfiskeboa shelter pending as an unofficial shelter inside Årås reserve; no fire claim should accompany it.
Import Trollsjön rastplats as rest area and only show fireplace/grill if it is treated as an official designated place under Stråkens strandskogar rules.
Keep Grillplats nära Mullsjö pending; clipping places it inside Stråkens strandskogar and the source is unofficial, so fire/camping claims need authority confirmation.
For Ryfors, separate official parking/toilet/rest access from no-fire/no-camping claims and clip exact objects before applying Ryfors versus Stråkens rules.

transit.defaultPolicy: Treat schedules and stop service as dynamic. This pass resolves which stops are suitable to import as confirmed access metadata versus weak/pending references.
resolvedActions: Holmens bro remains the section-1 weak end-access fallback; do not present Hestrafors IF as strong transit.
Komskälet/Kommskälet remains suppressed as a current stop; it was not found through checked Västtrafik sources/search on 2026-04-30.
Böne and Årås remain weak fixed-route endpoints; use parking/drop-off or pre-booked Västtrafik Närtrafik only as caveated access metadata.
Mullsjö Friluftshotellet is confirmed access metadata for section 10; JLT line 116 currently lists Mullsjö Friluftshotellet and a current timetable period 2025-08-11 to 2026-06-14.

protectedAreaClipChecks.result: No GPX vertices and no route segments intersected the Klippan naturreservat polygon in this check. Closest sampled route point was approximately 16 m from the reserve boundary.
protectedAreaClipChecks.importImpact: Do not attach Klippan reserve rules to section 1 as a route-overlap rule. Keep a proximity note only if desired.
protectedAreaClipChecks.caveat: This is a computational check against current NVR WFS geometry and GPX vertices/segments; a future GIS pipeline can repeat it with production geometry.

protectedAreaClipChecks.result: Årås route/start and Struntfiskeboa shelter/firepit coordinates fall inside Årås naturreservat.
protectedAreaClipChecks.importImpact: Apply Årås reserve context to the endpoint cluster. Suppress Struntfiskeboa firepit under the reserve no-fire rule; keep shelter overnight/use status pending.

protectedAreaClipChecks.result: Checked section-10 candidate coordinates did not fall inside the NVR Ryfors polygon in this point check, although the trail/facility context remains adjacent and the Länsstyrelsen page lists Ryfors visitor services.
protectedAreaClipChecks.importImpact: Do not blanket-apply Ryfors rules to every Ryfors-area facility without object-level clipping. Keep Ryfors reserve rules as nearby/protected-area context and apply to objects only when the production spatial check confirms overlap.

protectedAreaClipChecks.result: Several section-10 final-corridor facility candidates fall inside Stråkens strandskogar. The reserve allows fires only at designated places and with brought firewood.
protectedAreaClipChecks.importImpact: Trollsjön fireplace can be shown only if treated as an official designated place; Grillplats nära Mullsjö remains pending because its evidence is unofficial. Do not import free camping claims.
protectedAreaClipChecks.confidence: high for point-in-polygon; medium for exact fire-object legality until authority facility designation is confirmed

decisions: Klippan reserve overlap caveat reduced: current WFS/GPX check found no route intersection, only about 16 m proximity.
Keep Hestrafors IF/Bollevi as access cluster separate from the GPX endpoint.
Keep Hindås/Hindåsgården winter ski-track and seasonal facility access as publication-time warnings; no runtime integration until confirmed.
remainingDynamicChecks: Hindås/Hestrafors facility opening and potable-water availability

decisions: Keep Hestrafors and IK Omega/Omegastugan access semantics as already researched: route boundary at IK Omega, access cluster at Omegastugan/Olsfors.
Abborrsjön/Slätthult shelter and toilet remain pending-currentness rather than blockers; import with conservative currentness caveat or suppress until field/source confirmation.
Use Naturkartan endpoint for section 3/4 route continuity and model SOK-stugan/Nordtorp separately.
Represent Hultafors Vindskydd as one facility cluster with old/new shelter caveat instead of duplicate shelter records.
Suppress SOK-stugan clubhouse toilets/showers/sauna as public hiker services unless current public opening is verified.
Use Naturkartan route-continuity endpoints; model SOK-stugan and Rya åsar/Björbobacken/Ramshulan as access/facility clusters.
Deduplicate Högplatån/Björbobacken/Sjötorp/Rya åsar objects into the Rya åsar access/facility cluster.
Ramshulan water remains non-potable/unconfirmed service water; do not import as drinking water.
remainingDynamicChecks: Rya åsar reserve fire status and designated-place rules

decisions: Use Naturkartan/Västsverige geometry; keep Rya åsar and Karlsaflogarna practical access clusters separate from route vertices.
Deduplicate Kypesjön/Kypegården as one main facility cluster with separate south-side grillstuga only if the app supports distinct nearby objects.
Ymergården services are conditional/opening-hour metadata; do not present water/toilet/cafe as guaranteed.
Pending heritage/facility POIs without coordinates should be suppressed from import until coordinates are verified.
remainingDynamicChecks: Exact coordinates for optional heritage POIs

decisions: Normalize Rölle duplicate/spur geometry before route import.
Suppress Komskälet/Kommskälet as confirmed public transport until a live Västtrafik planner lookup proves it.
Import Raska-Minas stuga as day-use heritage/rest POI and Raska-Minas vindskydd as shelter with coordinate/currentness caveat.
Keep Raska-Minas spring non-potable/pending and grill as clustered pending object unless exact points are verified.
Treat Magsjön shelter/fireplace as day-use/pending until current condition and overnight status are verified.
Densify the 838.6 m simplified chord before geometry import.
Use route endpoint for continuity; model Prångens Camping, Prången badplats, parking/toilet and Ulricehamn services as deduplicated access/service clusters.
Suppress Komskälet/Kommskälet unless reverified; Blackered remains weak transit.
Keep Brunns kyrkoruin detailed access/safety claims pending until current signage/access is confirmed.
Böne coordinate caveat resolved: use easting 412026, not the stage-8 printed 4120226.
Use Naturkartan endpoints for geometry; model Prångens and Böne access clusters separately.
Import Jordkulan as heritage/rest cluster with shelter/fireplace/toilet/picnic/waste caveats, but mark spring as non-potable/unreliable and shelter overnight status as caveated.
Suppress Böne kyrka potable-water, toilet and open-church service claims.
Use one Årås endpoint cluster shared with section 10.
Struntfiskeboa firepit caveat resolved to suppress under Årås no-fire rule unless a later authority source overrides it.
Keep Struntfiskeboa shelter pending/unofficial inside Årås reserve.
Import Varpaledet as one bathing/rest cluster; do not split toilet/grill/changing/jetties until exact per-object coordinates are verified.
Suppress public potable-water claims for Böne, Varpaledet/Jogen and Årås.
remainingDynamicChecks: Årås lodging/cafe season and booking status
Varpaledet per-object coordinates if the app needs split facilities

decisions: Use one Årås endpoint cluster shared with section 9 and one Hotell Mullsjö endpoint cluster with separate hotel, ledentré, bus stop, bathing place and Mullsjö C access records.
Use Naturkartan GPX/API primary geometry; reverse OSM only as cross-check.
Use JLT Mullsjö Friluftshotellet and Mullsjö Resecentrum as confirmed endpoint access metadata, subject to live schedule refresh.
Treat Ryfors Golfklubb, Mullsjö Camping and Hotell Mullsjö water as guest/service metadata; keep Mullsjö Hotell tap pending exact public access verification.
Apply Stråkens designated-fireplace rule to Trollsjön and suppress/pending unofficial Grillplats nära Mullsjö fire/camping claims.
remainingDynamicChecks: JLT line 116 schedule at import/publication time
Mullsjö Hotell tap exact coordinate/public status

remainingImportDayChecks: Refresh fire-ban status for Härryda, Bollebygd, Borås, Ulricehamn and Mullsjö immediately before publication; reserve rules still override.
Refresh Västtrafik/JLT schedules and stop active status immediately before publication.
Run the production GIS pipeline to clip all facility points and route segments against protected-area polygons.
Verify public access/opening status for service facilities before exposing water/toilet/cafe/lodging as reliable hiker services.
Run geometry normalization/densification for section 6 and section 7 before any runtime route import.

importReadinessAfterThisPass.summary: The caveats now have explicit import decisions or dynamic-check deferrals. The remaining work is normalization execution, not broad research: endpoint/facility deduplication, geometry cleaning, production protected-area clipping, and publication-day live status refreshes.
importReadinessAfterThisPass.safeNextStep: Use this caveat-resolution file as the normalization checklist. Keep all work in candidate data until a separate explicit import task is approved.
